```{python}
#| label: fig-fp6-system
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Radio architecture of the Fairphone (Gen. 6), simplified from the published schematics. RF signals are drawn in black, digital data interfaces in blue, control buses in green, and PA supplies in red."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5, 5.6))
ax.set_xlim(0, 19)
ax.set_ylim(0, 11)
ax.axis('off')

def box(x, y, w, h, text, fc='white', fs=8.5, weight='normal'):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle='round,pad=0.05,rounding_size=0.15',
                                fc=fc, ec='k', lw=1.2))
    ax.text(x + w / 2, y + h / 2, text, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs, weight=weight)
    return (x, y, w, h)

def arrow(p0, p1, color='k', both=False, lw=1.3):
    ax.annotate('', xy=p1, xytext=p0,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<|-|>' if both else '-|>', color=color, lw=lw,
                                shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, mutation_scale=10))

fe, mod, rfic, soc = '#f2f2f2', '#fde9c8', '#cfe2f3', '#d9ead3'

# antennas and passive front-end
box(0.2, 1.0, 1.6, 9.0, '11\nantenna\nfeeds\n\n2 with\ntuners\n(QAT5618)', fc=fe)
box(2.4, 1.0, 2.2, 9.0, 'diplexers,\ntriplexers,\n\nantenna\nswitches\n(SPnT, DPnT)', fc=fe)
box(5.2, 1.0, 2.2, 9.0, 'SAW/BAW\nfilters,\n\nduplexers,\nB1/B3\nquadplexer,\n\ncouplers', fc=fe)

# active front-end modules
m_lna = box(8.0, 7.6, 2.9, 2.4, 'LNA modules\nLB PRX (QLN5020)\nMHB DRX (QLN5030)\nMHB PRX (QLN5040)', fc=mod)
m_uhb = box(8.0, 5.3, 2.9, 1.9, 'n77/n78 modules\nPA + LNA (QPM2980)\nDRX/MIMO (QDM3980)', fc=mod)
m_pa = box(8.0, 3.0, 2.9, 1.9, '2 multimode PAs\nLB/MB/HB (MMPA)\nGSM PA (QPA2625)', fc=mod)
m_gnss = box(8.0, 1.0, 2.9, 1.6, 'GNSS L1/L5\nSAW + LNA', fc=mod)
apt = box(11.15, 3.1, 1.0, 0.8, '2 APT\nQET3930', fc='#f4cccc', fs=7)

# transceivers and SoC
sdr = box(12.6, 3.0, 2.6, 7.0, 'SDR735\n\ncellular\nRFIC\n\n+ GNSS RX\n+ FBRX', fc=rfic, fs=9.5, weight='bold')
wcn = box(12.6, 0.4, 2.6, 1.8, 'WCN6755\nWi-Fi 6E 2x2\nBT 5.4', fc=rfic, fs=8.5)
box(16.6, 0.4, 2.2, 9.6, 'SM7635\n\nSoC\n\nmodem\n+\napplication\nprocessor', fc=soc, fs=9.5, weight='bold')

# RF connections
for y in (2.0, 5.5, 8.5):
    arrow((1.8, y), (2.4, y), both=True)
    arrow((4.6, y), (5.2, y), both=True)
for (x, y, w, h) in (m_lna, m_uhb):
    arrow((7.4, y + h / 2), (x, y + h / 2), both=(m_uhb[1] == y))
    arrow((x + w, y + h / 2), (12.6, y + h / 2))
x, y, w, h = m_gnss
arrow((7.4, y + h / 2), (x, y + h / 2))
ax.plot([x + w, 12.35, 12.35], [y + h / 2, y + h / 2, 3.3], color='k', lw=1.3)
arrow((12.35, 3.3), (12.6, 3.3))
arrow((12.6, 4.5), (m_pa[0] + m_pa[2], 4.5))
arrow((m_pa[0], 4.5), (7.4, 4.5))
arrow((apt[0], 3.5), (m_pa[0] + m_pa[2], 3.5), color='tab:red')
arrow((7.4, 0.7), (12.6, 0.7), both=True)
ax.text(11.9, 0.75, 'Wi-Fi/BT RF', fontsize=7, ha='right', va='bottom')

# digital interfaces and control
arrow((15.2, 7.5), (16.6, 7.5), color='tab:blue', both=True)
ax.text(15.9, 7.6, 'QLink', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='bottom', color='tab:blue')
arrow((15.2, 1.3), (16.6, 1.3), color='tab:blue', both=True)
ax.text(15.9, 1.4, 'PCIe', fontsize=7, ha='center', va='bottom', color='tab:blue')
ax.plot([13.9, 13.9, 9.45, 9.45], [10.0, 10.6, 10.6, 10.0], color='tab:green', lw=1.3)
ax.text(11.7, 10.65, 'MIPI RFFE buses + GPIO (band select, gain, bias)', fontsize=7,
        ha='center', va='bottom', color='tab:green')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
